title: DiffusionBlocks: Training Neural Networks One Block at a Time
author: Makoto Shing
site_name: Automating the Search for Artificial Life with Foundation Models
summary: DiffusionBlocks is a new way to train neural networks by dividing them into smaller blocks and training one block at a time. This method uses less memory but still performs well on tasks like image and text generation. It could make AI training easier and more accessible for everyone, even with limited hardware.
